examples.explanation: "abcw" (length 4) and "xtfn" (length 4) use disjoint letters, giving 4 * 4 = 16, which is best possible.
Every pair shares the letter 'a', so no valid pair exists.

hints: Encode each word as a 26-bit mask of its letters; disjoint pairs are those with (maskA & maskB) == 0.
Compare all pairs of masks and keep the best length product.
Duplicate masks can be compressed by keeping only the longest word per mask.
title: 407. Maximum Product of Word Lengths
